refnamediv.refpurpose: Estimate the fall time of a negative-going bilevel waveform.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: f = falltime(x) f = falltime(x, t) f = falltime(x, Fs) f = falltime(x, t, 'PercentReferenceLevels', N) f = falltime(x, t, 'Tolerance', M) f = falltime(x, t, 'StateLevels', O) [f, lowercrossvalue, uppercrossvalue, lowerreference, upperreference] = falltime(x) [f, lowercrossvalue, uppercrossvalue, lowerreference, upperreference] = falltime(x, Fs) [f, lowercrossvalue, uppercrossvalue, lowerreference, upperreference] = falltime(x, t) [f, lowercrossvalue, uppercrossvalue, lowerreference, upperreference] = falltime(x, t, 'PercentReferenceLevels', N) [f, lowercrossvalue, uppercrossvalue, lowerreference, upperreference] = falltime(x, t, 'Tolerance', M) [f, lowercrossvalue, uppercrossvalue, lowerreference, upperreference] = falltime(x, t, 'StateLevels', O) [f, lowercrossvalue, uppercrossvalue, lowerreference, upperreference] = falltime(x, t, 'StateLevels', O, 'fig', 'on' or 'off')

listitem.para: Positive scalar. Specifies the sample rate, where the first sample instant corresponds to a time of zero.
Vector or positive scalar. Defines the sample time instants or the sample rate.
Two-element vector. Specifies the percent reference levels as percentages. Default is [10, 90].
Real scalar. Specifies the tolerance value. Default is 2.0.
Two-element real vector. Defines the lower and upper state levels.
String. Specifies whether to display the figure ('on' or 'off'). Default is 'off'.
Vector. Returns the fall time of negative-going bilevel waveform transitions.
Vector. Returns the lower cross values.
Vector. Returns the upper cross values.
Scalar. Returns the lower reference value corresponding to the lower percent reference level.
Scalar. Returns the upper reference value corresponding to the upper percent reference level.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function estimates the fall time of a negative-going bilevel waveform. It calculates the time difference between the upper and lower percent reference levels of the waveform.

refsection.title: Examples
refsection.programlisting: Fs = 1e6 // 1 MHz sampling rate x = [3.3, 3.3, 3.2, 2.5, 1.0, 0.2, 0.0, 0.0] // Simulated digital fall f = falltime(x, Fs)
